title: De novo generation of dual-target compounds using artificial intelligence
summary: De novo generation of dual-target compounds using artificial intelligence. Generative methods designed compounds predicted to bind both ADORA2A and PDE4D. 10 compounds were synthesized and profiled in binding assays against 39 human proteins; 3 interacted with both targets with high specificity. Evidence limits: Functional activity in cells or animals was not reported in the abstract; potency not assessed. Reviewed from Europe PMC abstract only.
ai_technology: Genetic-algorithm fragment assembly and GAN-based reinforcement learning generators
